perf-client-audit.source: Baseline read-only audit429e373; implementation on ROOTPERFREADY3f07a8b plus current working tree.
perf-client-audit.method: Controlled Node/V8 CPU and heap measurements in the existing repository harness. Not native browser layout, mobile FPS, actual network or decoded-image memory measurements. Counterfactual changes exist only inside a VM context.

primaryBottleneck.evidence: With every manual advanced field empty, 52,870 lots each rebuild filterFamilies and categorize their family. The empty render still runs all 52,870 live/money validations, so the proposed reduction removes redundant UI criteria work rather than weakening eligibility.
primaryBottleneck.proposal: Implemented the bounded transient per-render manual-filter/families snapshot; readAdvancedFilters public/saved shape is unchanged.

counterfactual.method: In-memory counterfactual only. Actual production advancedMatches body with one per-render has-manual-filters flag and precomputed categories. Keyword intent matching, live lifecycle and financial guards remain unchanged.

primaryBottleneck.equivalence: Exact IDs and order match in all six cases: empty, nearest, explicit vehicle year+fuel, natural BMW year/gearbox/budget, natural apartment area+rooms, and explicit price/radius. Live and bank money guard call counts are unchanged.

otherObservations: Bootstrap synchronously generates and normalizes all 52,870 local demo objects; four boots show roughly 61–79MiB heap delta. Broad asynchronous generation would require a larger state-management change and is not proposed as a quick rewrite.
Default clean-load app-ui initialization causes no extra full render in the measured harness.

Featured initialization adds one 52,870-lot eligibility pass (203–214ms here). Reusing eligibility across unrelated mutations would require careful version/clock invalidation; leave that guard intact in the first bounded patch.
Photo error fallback loops were not confirmed: featured and buyer thumbnails already use one-shot fallback markers, and the full-photo error handler reports status without re-requesting the image.
Photo rendering is bounded to the mounted cards. Responsive delivery/request canonicalization belongs to the photo-performance agent.
perf-client-audit.status: Production index fragments and new regression frozen; parent owns subsequent photo/head/cache integration and full QA.

implementation.scope: Only advancedMatches and the existing per-render manual-filter count/families snapshot fragment. No gallery/card/image/head/cache edits by this agent.
implementation.behavior: Each render attaches hasManualFilters/categoryFamilies to its transient criteria object. No cross-render cache and no extra metadata in readAdvancedFilters or saved-search records. Direct/saved callers without metadata retain their ordinary criteria evaluation. Keyword intent and every live/money guard remain active.

productionAfter.qualification: Same controlled harness, small samples; before run included V8 CPU profiling, after did not. Use call-count reduction and equivalent results as primary evidence; these timings do not establish mobile FPS/network performance or retained-memory improvements.
